native_gc.interpretation: Many slow frames overlap actual7-9ms collector stops; some large outliers have no overlap. Stop/resume overhead is dominated by stopped work, not suspension/resumption. No claim GC explains every spike.

scheduled_pose_experiment.scope: Same session, 5x30s, radius10m eye-height route, 100 distinct people. All zero unfocused frames. Automatic poses remain OFF by default; ~3% average improvement is modest and does not meet crowd goal. Half-ms GC slice remains experimental only.
